summary: Crook County, OR point: crow's nest 1926 (platform 1920), 50 ft L-6 tower with cabin 1934 (65 ft per 1933 news), removed or destroyed in the 1960s; no source describes remains.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and Forest Fire Lookout Association date the crow's nest to 1926; Forest Lookouts documents a platform planned in 1920 and a fire finder in 1919. The story reports both.

Register and Forest Fire Lookout Association give a 50-foot tower; a 1933 newspaper item describes a 65-foot tower under construction. The sources do not settle the finished height, so the story gives the 50-foot figure with the 1933 report and no height_m is recorded.
Register says removed in the 1960s; Forest Fire Lookout Association says destroyed in the 1960s. Both are reported.

Register says he was responsible for building the original lookout but never staffed it; Forest Fire Lookout Association calls him the first lookout; the 1933 newspaper says he first used the point as a lookout.

notes_for_editor: Brief height_m 19.8 (65 ft) matches only the 1933 construction-stage newspaper item; register and Forest Fire Lookout Association say 50 ft, so height_m was left out pending your call. Brief's FFLOS registration date (June 23, 2011) is not in the fetched register text, so no fflos_registered event was added. A web search summary claimed no 1934 Ingram Point lookout existed and pointed to Gerow Butte; that is not a fetched source and was not used. The Komoot listing is a thin source for today's status. Photos not added: the page text carries no image URLs.
